notes.title: Steam Summer Sale 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! From June 26th to July 10th, [i]Rain and Respite[/i] and the Artbook DLC are on sale for 40% off as a part of the 2025 Steam Summer Sale! Consider picking up a copy if you haven't already, and if you've already gotten the game, consider buying it as a gift for a friend! Or a family member! Or dog! Or mortal blood enemy that you want to lull into a false sense of security with a cutesy game before you backstab them in some strangely contrived fashion![/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you all for the overwhelming support for this little VN, it's been over half a year since it first released, and it means the world to me that so many people enjoyed the characters and the story.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy your summer, and make sure not to drink too much![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.01
notes.notes:
Hey all, just a small patch to fix and polish some stuff:

- The Ren'Py engine has been updated to the most stable version (8.3.3)
- Music has been edited slightly so the intros and outros are shorter and makes looping more cohesive
- Fixed a slight quirk where in one dialogue conversation, Granite was listed as the speaker instead of Guard

It's also worth noting that the game should have proper Steam Cloud Save support on all platforms! Just in case you wanted to compliment giant hats or make elves cry at home or on the go.

As a final sendoff I just wanted to thank everyone for the wild amount of support for the release of this project, and reading all the reviews and feedback has been incredibly humbling. Thank you all so much!!

ThunderSalt
